card.name: Journal header and dictionary punctuation
card.fires_on: Punctuation or short label words in scientific-article headers (keywords, ISSN, received dates, Mexican affiliations) and the slash after a headword in dictionary pronunciations. Also fires inside the word hyperkalemia.

modes.label: Article header metadata
modes.description: Colons, periods or labels in Spanish-language journal headers such as keywords, ISSN, received dates and addresses.

modes.label: Dictionary pronunciation slash
modes.description: The slash after a medical term that introduces its syllable breakdown.

modes.label: Inside hyperkalemia
modes.description: The middle piece of the word hyperkalemia.
